c1-crab-rules: Collect every shell, then reach home. Tap commands to build your plan. Tap a card to replace it, insert before it, or remove it. Press Go to watch the crab walk.
c1-crab-mud-rules: Mud costs two walking steps. Sand costs one. Turns cost no steps. The walking step budget is not a clock. You can plan for as long as you like.
c1-crab-debug-rules: This plan has a bug. Tap a card to select it. Then choose Replace, Insert before, or Remove card. Press Go to try your change.
c1-crab-budget: That route costs too many walking steps. Your plan is kept. Try walking around the mud.
c1-crab-first-hint: Here is one step to try. Change, insert, or remove the card shown. Press Help again when you want another step.
c1-crab-more-help: Try that one step first, or ask for the whole plan. Helped finishes count too.
c1-crab-retry: Your plan is kept. Change a card, undo an edit, or try another puzzle.
c1-crab-footprints: Footprints are off for this dare. Help is still here.
c1-crab-marks: Your mark is kept. Marks are never spent or lost, and every puzzle stays open.
c1-crab-mud-teach: Walk across this patch to try it. Mud costs two walking steps.
c1-crab-mud-detour: The straight path costs seven walking steps. You have six. Can a longer plan walk around the mud?
c1-crab-mud-twist: Cards and walking steps are different. A short plan can cost more walking steps.
c1-crab-lesson-m7: A turn points the wrong way. Tap a card, then Replace it.
c1-crab-lesson-m2: A card is missing. Tap a card, then Insert before.
c1-crab-lesson-m4: One extra card sends the crab away. Tap it, then Remove.
c1-crab-lesson-m8: Two neighbouring cards traded places. Replace them, then Go.
c1-crab-lesson-mud-3: The shell sits in a little pocket. Visit it, then find a dry way home.
c1-crab-lesson-mud-4: A sandcastle blocks the straight path. Look for a dry crossing.
c1-crab-lesson-mud-6: The shortest plan costs 9 steps. You have 8. Find one extra card that avoids a muddy step.
c1-crab-lesson-mud-7: One small patch to finish. The budget is roomy: choose your own route.
c1-crab-hint-change: Change the card shown to this command.
c1-crab-hint-insert: Insert this command before the card shown.
c1-crab-hint-remove: Remove the card shown. Keep the other cards.
